title: ProteinGeoBench: Frontier Structural-Biology Agents Are Fluent at Lookup but Lost in Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.26829v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: ProteinGeoBench is a set of 131 tasks that give an agent protein structure files and ask it to look up recorded facts, check sequences, calculate geometry from atom coordinates or reason about structures. We ran four frontier models on every task several times (4,249 runs) and 26 models on a subset. A single overall score hides two different skills. Three of the four frontier models are best at looking up facts and worst at calculating from coordinates: Claude Opus 5 scores 0.907 on lookup and 0.716 on calculation. Gemini 3.1 Pro is the exception. Geometry is overrepresented among the hardest tasks. Half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail are calculations, although calculations are a fifth of the suite, and eight of the twelve were solved by none of the 26 models. translated_title: ProteinGeoBench：前沿结构生物学智能体擅长信息查找，却在几何问题上迷失方向
translated_abstract: ProteinGeoBench是一个包含131个任务的基准测试集，它为智能体提供蛋白质结构文件，要求其查找已记录的事实、检查序列、根据原子坐标计算几何量或对结构进行推理。研究团队在每个任务上对四个前沿模型进行了多次运行（共计4,249次），并在一个子集上测试了26个模型。结果表明，单一的总分掩盖了两种截然不同的能力：四个前沿模型中有三个最擅长查找事实，而最不擅长基于坐标进行计算——例如Claude Opus 5在查找任务上得分为0.907，但在计算任务上仅为0.716。Gemini 3.1 Pro是唯一的例外。几何类任务在最难的任务中占比过高：在四个模型全部失败的十二个任务中，有一半是计算类任务，尽管计算类任务仅占整个测试集的五分之一，且其中八个任务在26个模型中无一能解决。三个领先模型之间的分差在0.031以内，差距过小而难以排序，且若每个任务只运行一次，在24%的bootstrap重采样中排名第一的模型会有所不同。
tldr: 本文提出包含131个结构生物学任务的ProteinGeoBench基准，通过对4,249次模型运行的分析发现，前沿模型擅长事实查找但普遍在基于原子坐标的几何计算任务上失败，揭示了当前模型几何推理能力的重大短板。
en_tdlr: ProteinGeoBench, a 131-task benchmark for structural-biology agents, reveals through 4,249 model runs that frontier models excel at fact lookup but consistently fail at coordinate-based geometric calculations, exposing a critical weakness in geometric reasoning.
